display_long_description:
# Build. Program. Pilot. Compete.

ASMBL is a multiplayer VR sandbox where you can build anything from simple machines to massive, fully functional vehicles that you climb inside and drive around.

Try out this free demo and see for yourself!

# Build Without Limits.

From minifigs to monuments, ASMBL gives you the tools to create a world of your own. Build practical machines that solve problems, elegant engineering marvels, or completely unnecessary contraptions that probably should never have been built.

With 300+ part types, 40+ materials, and an ever-growing collection of mechanical, electronic, and structural components, there is no single right way to build.

# Create Your Own Avatar.

Why stop at machines? Build your own VR avatar and express yourself however you want. Create something recognizable, ridiculous, or completely unique—and bring it with you into the world of ASMBL.

# Features

* 300+ buildable part types
* 40+ unique materials
* Motors, pistons, servos, wheels, wings, propellers, rockets, gyroscopes, suction cups, proximity sensors, and more
* Machine guns, rocket launchers, blasters, missile launchers, and laser cannons
* Game controllers, steering wheels, HOTAS, tank steering, and body motion control
* Buildable VR avatars
* Share creations with other players
